name: Team Charmander: Hyper-Offense & Fighting Wallbreaker (Remix)
archetype: Fast Fire STAB pressure, Water/Grass resistance pivot, and Counter physical punishment.
gym_duel_rationale: Brock's Steel-hybrid team is naturally vulnerable to Fire and Fighting. Enter the arena with Charmander (Ember deals 2x super-effective damage to Steelix/Mime Jr.) and Riolu (Counter punishes physical contact while Fighting typing threatens Aron/Psyduck).

roster.progression_notes: All 4 moves learned naturally by Lv. 13. Ember deals 2x super-effective damage into Steelix/Mime Jr. while Smokescreen disrupts Brock's accuracy.
Caught on Route 2. Water/Grass typing resists Aron/Psyduck's Water moves while providing Grass sustain via Absorb.
Caught in Secret Garden at Lv. 2. Counter inflicts double the physical damage taken back onto opponents, easily OHKOing Steelix.

flex_bench.why_use: Caught on Route 1 at night. Quick Attack priority helps finish weakened leads.
Caught on Route 1. High Speed and Peck sweep Viridian Forest bugs with ease.
